title: publisher-docker plugin configuration
description: Schema v1 for publishing one existing local Docker image.

SEMREL_PLUGIN_IMAGE.description: Existing local Docker image reference or image ID.

SEMREL_PLUGIN_REF.description: Tagged destination Docker reference containing the {version} placeholder.

SEMREL_VERSION.description: Resolved release version. Takes precedence over SEMREL_NEXT_VERSION.

SEMREL_NEXT_VERSION.description: Release version fallback when SEMREL_VERSION is empty.

SEMREL_DRY_RUN.description: Inspect and plan without tagging or pushing.
